KEY FEATURES
• Buffett Indicator: the total value of the US stock market (Wilshire 5000) relative to US GDP, updated every day
• Shiller PE (CAPE): the cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings ratio of the S&P 500, backed by 140+ years of history
• Historical comparison: see how today's valuation stacks up against past decades
• Valuation gauges: Color bands show at a glance how stretched the market is
• Home Screen widget: today's readings without opening the app
• Daily alert: a notification when the numbers update

Built for long-term investors and macro watchers who want data, not headlines.

Data comes from public sources: the Wilshire 5000, US GDP and S&P 500 earnings. For information and education only; not investment advice. Not affiliated with Warren Buffett or Berkshire Hathaway.

Every calculation. In context.

CalcTape combines a calculator, an editable calculation tape and space for notes. Plan a trip, check shopping costs, or track expenses while keeping your numbers and notes together.

KEEP EVERY STEP IN VIEW
Enter several items, create subtotals and add comments beside the numbers. Use arithmetic, percentages, powers and other functions while keeping longer calculations easy to follow.

CHANGE A FIGURE, UPDATE THE RESULTS
Edit a number or an operator, insert a line or remove an item. CalcTape recalculates the results below automatically. Undo and Redo let you reverse and restore changes.

SAVE YOUR WORK
Keep calculations as documents, reopen them later and reuse them as templates. The document list shows the storage location, date and line count. Choose whether a document opens at the beginning, at the last position or at the end.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Customize keyboard layouts and create user keys for frequently used functions or text. Choose from five themes, including Dark Night with a dark calculation tape, keyboard and dialogs.

SHARE AND CONTINUE
Share calculations as text, HTML or CalcTape files through the iOS share sheet, or print them. Use iCloud Drive to access your documents on other devices.

FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
The calculation tape and keyboard adapt to the app window. On iPad, work alongside another app.

CalcTape is now also available in Ukrainian and Malay.

Available on macOS, iOS, iPadOS, and visionOS

CheckCraft lets you easily print personal checks from your Mac, iPhone, iPad, or Vision Pro, with all your data securely synced via iCloud.

# Key Features:

- Print checks on blank check stock from your Mac, iPhone, iPad or Vision Pro
- Routing and account numbers at the standard bank (MICR) positions, in the business or personal order
- The fractional routing number from your bank's checks
- Line up your printer with a test page and fine adjustments
- Print several checks at once
- A register of printed, deposited and voided checks, with filters and totals
- Void or duplicate checks, with payee suggestions from earlier checks
- Export to CSV, or QIF for Quicken and QuickBooks
- Siri, Shortcuts and Spotlight
- Backed up and synced with iCloud
- Lock with Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode
- Multiple accounts
- Built for U.S. banks (USD only), one check layout: CheckOMatic

Note: CheckCraft currently supports only the CheckOMatic check layout.

# Frequently Asked Questions

## Can I try it before buying?

There's no free trial, but if CheckCraft isn't a good fit, you can request a refund: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT204084

## Where can I buy compatible checks?

You can purchase CheckOMatic checks from Amazon: https://amzn.to/45NJpUX

## Can I customize the check layout or use other formats?

Not yet. Currently, only the CheckOMatic format is supported.
If there’s enough interest, we may add more layouts in future updates.

## Are there alternatives?

Yes. If you prefer a simpler or manual approach, you can use Excel or Numbers templates. 
Check out this open-source project: https://github.com/andrewstellman/excel-check-printing

# Privacy Policy

We believe very strongly in our customers’ right to privacy. Our customer records are not for sale or trade, and we will not disclose our customer data to any third party except as may be required by law.

Any information that you provide to us in the course of interacting with our sales or technical support departments is held in strict confidence. This includes your contact information (including, but not limited to your email address and phone number), as well as any data that you supply to us in the course of a technical support interaction.

# Support

Have suggestions, feature requests, or feedback?
Reach out at: support@loshadki.app

Where did the money go this month? My Wallet+ shows you — clearly, in your own numbers. Log what you spend and earn in seconds, and the picture builds itself: where your money goes, what comes in, and how this month compares to the last. Once you can see it, changing it gets a lot easier.

SEE WHERE IT GOES
Your spending, sorted into the categories that fit your life. Tap any category to see what's inside it, down to the last coffee. Make the categories your own — names, icons, subcategories.

KNOW WHAT COMES IN
Switch to income to see salary and everything else side by side with your spending, and the balance across your accounts — cash, cards, savings, even accounts in different currencies.

EVERY DAY COUNTS
Small purchases are the ones that add up. Adding one takes a few taps, and the calendar shows each day's spending at a glance, so nothing slips by.

RENT, SALARY AND SUBSCRIPTIONS
Set them up once and see them ahead of time, every month. Skip or adjust a single payment without touching the rest.

IS IT GETTING BETTER?
Turn your phone sideways for the Analyzer: months side by side as lines or bars, income against spending, and where each month's money went. It's where habits become visible.

YOUR MONTH STARTS ON PAYDAY
Money doesn't follow the calendar, so neither does My Wallet+. Start your month on the day your salary arrives — the 25th, the 1st, whatever yours is — and every view follows.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN, YOURS TO KEEP
No account to create and no tracking: your data stays on your devices and syncs through your own iCloud, so your iPhones stay in step. No ads and no subscriptions either — pay once, use forever.

COMING FROM AN EARLIER VERSION?
My Wallet+ has been rebuilt from the ground up. Your history comes with you: transactions, accounts, categories and recurring payments are imported on first launch, and backups from the previous version can be restored from iCloud.

Available in English, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish and Swedish.

Since 2010, My Wallet+ has helped people around the world get a clear view of their money — chosen by Apple as Best Finance App two years running, and number one in Finance in 100 countries.

Questions or ideas? Visit block21.com, write to us at support@block21.com, or follow My Wallet+ on Facebook (facebook.com/mywalletapp) and Twitter (@mywalletapp).

Comprehensive preparation, study and test tool for the Remote Pilot Initial (Unmanned Aircraft General - Small) FAA Knowledge Exam. Questions, answers and explanations included, for you to study with a true-to-form practice test.

Operating a drone for non-hobby operations requires a Remote Pilot Certificate. Applicants must successfully complete the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Knowledge Exam to earn the Remote Pilot Certificate with a Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS) rating. This app is the key to test success.

Rely on the time-tested and dependable ASA Prepware apps to prepare for your FAA Knowledge Exam. Test material is expertly organized into chapters based on subject matter and includes instructional text and illustrations, multiple-choice questions, answer stems, correct answers, explanations (for correct and incorrect answers), and references for further study. This topical study promotes understanding and aids recall to provide an efficient study guide. 

Subjects covered include Regulations, National Airspace System, Weather, Loading and Performance, and Operations. This app will be particularly helpful for drone operators interested in earning a Remote Pilot certificate, Remote Pilot Aircraft (RPA) applicants, Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) training programs preparing applicants for FAA Knowledge exams, self-study applicants interested in learning more about commercial unmanned aircraft operations, and existing (manned aircraft) pilots interested in learning more about drone and unmanned aircraft operations who are sharing the National Airspace System.

ASA’s Prepware Remote Pilot app is the best resource for successful test-taking and safe small UAS operations.

leads.description:
Sporty's Study Buddy prepares you for the FAA Private Pilot knowledge test (the "written") with three ways to study: Study Questions, Flashcards and Practice Tests. Questions are organized by knowledge area, with explanations of the right and wrong answers developed by Sporty's team of Master CFIs, based on their experience preparing students for the Private Pilot certificate.

• STUDY QUESTIONS BY TOPIC •

Choose whole knowledge areas or individual topics to build your own study session. As soon as you answer, you'll see the correct answer, why it's right, and where to read more. Change your answer anytime, bookmark questions as you go, and jump to any question from the question list. Every study session is shuffled.

• REVIEW WITH FLASHCARDS •

Flashcards show just the question, so you answer from memory before revealing the correct answer and its explanation. Mark each card Know It or Still Learning, then start a new session from the cards you're still learning. On iPhone Duo, study a card with the phone open and close it to check the answer.

• TAKE PRACTICE TESTS •

Each Practice Test draws 60 questions at random from the full question bank, gives you 2 hours, and is graded at the FAA's 70% passing score. Afterward, see your score by topic, review every question or only the ones you missed, and turn your misses into a new study session.

• PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF •

Sessions save as you go. The History tab lets you resume any session in progress and review past results, including your scores by topic.

• EVERY FIGURE, OFFLINE •

The Figures tab includes the complete FAA Airman Knowledge Testing Supplement, with every figure and legend listed by name and page. Swipe through the pages or open any one full screen. Questions show their figures right alongside, and you can study without a connection.

Designed for iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad, with Dark Mode and support for larger text sizes.

The FAA does not publish its knowledge test questions, so the questions on your test won't necessarily appear in this app. Study Buddy is meant to complement your training, not to replace flight and ground instruction.

Using a question-and-answer format, Private Pilot Checkride lists the questions most likely to be asked by examiners during the last step in the pilot certification process – the Practical Exam – and provides succinct, ready responses. Pilots will find this App an indispensable tool in both planning for what to expect during the airplane checkride and mastering the subject matter. Instructors rate them as excellent preparation for students, as well as preps for Flight Reviews, aircraft transitions, and as general refresher material.


This Private Pilot Checkride app is based on the popular Private Oral Exam Guide book by Jason Blair and aligns with the FAA Airman Certification Standards (ACS). It is designed for student pilots training for the Private Pilot Certificate with an airplane rating. More than 900 questions and responses ensure all the subjects a Private Pilot candidate will be tested on during a checkride and review flight are covered. Topics include: pilot qualifications and limitations, aircraft airworthiness requirements, preflight procedures, postflight procedures, human factors, performance and limitations, airport operations, national airspace system, weather information, cross-country flight planning, night operations, emergency equipment and survival gear, and scenario-based training. Answers and explanations were researched using FAA documents (which are identified so pilots know where to go for further study) as well as interviewing FAA examiners and include the corresponding ACS code. Questions can be marked for further study from any subject to build your own collection of flashcards. An Applicant Practical Test Checklist and quick-reference to the Private Pilot maneuvers and tolerances (as defined in the Airman Certification Standards) are also included.

Compatible with iOS phones and tablets, this app teaches applicants not only what to expect, but also how to exhibit subject mastery and confidence when under the examiner’s scrutiny. It identifies candidates’ strengths, weaknesses, and gaps in their aeronautical knowledge, which increases study efficiency.

App features:
• More than 800 questions are included with succinct, ready responses.
• Questions from any subject can be flagged for further study into a separate group.
• Includes all the questions and answers from the popular book, Private Pilot Oral Exam Guide by Jason Blair.
• Answers supported with FAA references and ACS codes.
• Brought to you by a trusted resource in aviation training and publishing, Aviation Supplies & Academics (ASA).

Flashnote Derby is a fun, effective way for kids to learn to read music through fast-paced note flashcard games.
Perfect for piano, guitar, band, orchestra, and general music students, this teacher-created app turns note recognition into an engaging game that works equally well at home or in music lessons.

————

Learn to Read Music — Fast

Each race is a fast-paced challenge: identify notes correctly as you learn to read music faster and speed your horse toward the finish line. Missed or slow answers allow the other horse to catch up.
After each round, students can review the notes they missed— turning every race into a meaningful learning opportunity.

————

New! Practice Mode (No Timer, No Stress)

Students can now choose a relaxed 'practice mode' with unlimited time for each note.
Perfect for beginners, this mode builds accuracy and confidence before racing competitively.

————

Multiple Ways to Answer

Players can answer flashcards in a variety of ways:
• Play the note on any instrument. Flashnote Derby listens and recognizes what you play (including transposing instruments).
• Use a MIDI instrument
• Tap on-screen letter names
• Or play notes on the on-screen piano keyboard

————

Fully Customizable for Any Student

Tailor each drill to match your student’s level:
• Treble, bass, alto, or tenor clef
• Select specific note ranges or individual notes
• Add sharps, flats, or full key signatures
• Adjust time limits (or remove them entirely in Practice Mode)
• Expand difficulty all the way up to five-and-a-half ledger lines above and below the staff.

As skills grow, you can increase the challenge. Higher difficulty earns higher scores—keeping students motivated.

————

Multiple themes keep practice fresh

In addition to the classic horse race, students can take flight with the whimsical Pretty Pegasus course, blast through an arcade-style space challenge in Ecliptic Encounter, or switch to the seasonal Reindeer Race during the holidays.

————

Built for Teachers, Loved by Students

Flashnote Derby is designed to fit easily into lessons:
• Quick to set up and perfect for a 1–2 minute warm-up
• Send homework assignments directly to students
• Track progress automatically
• See which notes need more review

Teachers see real improvement. Students stay engaged. Parents appreciate the progress.

————

Why Flashnote Derby Works

Many students struggle because drilling note names feels boring and difficult. Flashnote Derby turns this essential skill into a game—one they’ll want to keep playing.
A little daily practice adds up quickly, and students learn to read music with confidence.

————

Get on the road to confident music reading today!

Download Flashnote Derby and help your young musician master notes with joy—not frustration.

ECHOCAT is the iPhone and iPad companion for POTACAT, the desktop app for amateur radio operators chasing Parks on the Air (POTA), Summits on the Air (SOTA), Worldwide Bunkers on the Air (WWBOTA), Tiles on the Air and DX. 

Connect your iPad or iPhone to your shack computer from anywhere in the world. POTACAT Cloud Tunnel (optional subscription) handles the remote connection with no router config, no port forwarding, and no VPN setup — it’s the easiest path. If you prefer to bring your own networking, ECHOCAT also works over Tailscale, WireGuard, or 44NetConnect. On your local network, ECHOCAT works out of the box for free. From any of these paths you have comprehensive remote control of your shack, allowing you to work all your favorite modes.

Remote SSB, CW, FT8 and SSTV! Imagine you're stuck in that long line at the supermarket and you get a notification your buddy is on a summit. Just open up ECHOCAT, QSY to their frequency and call them on single side band with the Push to Talk button. Or send a CW Macro. Or connect your TinyMIDI from N6ARA and send them your fist. Snap a photo and mock up a quick SSTV and bounce it off the ionosphere. Or my most used mode - chase rare DX on FT8 (and FT4 and FT2) when you wake up in the middle of the night for a quick run to the powder room. It's really that easy -- then log it all with one click. Slick!

Select the entities you want to chase (POTA, SOTA, DX Clusters, WWFF, LLOTA, Tiles on the Air) and the region you want to see (North America, South America, Europe, etc), and enjoy two views: 

SPOTS View - See all the spots in a nice, large view showcasing the operator's callsign, name, distance from your QTH, mode and park/summit

MAP View - See a beautiful map with pins at all the activating spots. Click a spot to see their callsign, 1-click tune to them by pressing "QSY" and work the contact on SSB or CW. 

DIRECTORY view shows a list of current and upcoming HF nets, as well as Short Wave Listening (SWL) stations. Now you can tune into a net on a long drive and chat with your buddies, or catch the latest from Voice of Turkey.

By utilizing the SDR connection, you can connect ECHOCAT to your favorite KiwiSDR or WebSDR so you can listen to spots and nets even when your shack rig is unavailable. 

POTACAT CLOUD (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)

Subscribe to POTACAT Cloud to back up your logbook and sync QSOs between your phone and every desktop you operate from. Built for activators in the field, contesters with portable stations, and anyone with more than one shack.

+ POTACAT Cloud Tunnel — remote rig control from anywhere on the internet, no VPN required
+ Guest Pass — issue a time-limited, owner-revocable code that lets another licensed operator drive your station for a contest, a club session, or remote help. Server-enforced TX power and band limits
+ Cross-device QSO sync — log on mobile when your desktop is offline, watch it appear when you get home
+ Cloud backup with full ADIF export
+ Settings sync between devices
+ Multiple computers, one canonical log
+ Widgets to embed on QRZ that show your latest activation, total QSOs and more

73s,

Connect your iPad or iPhone to your shack computer from anywhere in the world. POTACAT Cloud Tunnel (optional subscription) handles the remote connection with no router config, no port forwarding, and no VPN setup — it’s the easiest path. If you prefer to bring your own networking, ECHOCAT also works over Tailscale, WireGuard, or 44NetConnect. On your local network, ECHOCAT works out of the box for free. From any of these paths you have comprehensive remote control of your shack, allowing you to work all your favorite modes.

Remote SSB, CW, FT8 and SSTV! Imagine you're stuck in that long line at the supermarket and you get a notification your buddy is on a summit. Just open up ECHOCAT, QSY to their frequency and call them on single side band with the Push to Talk button. Or send a CW Macro. Or connect your TinyMIDI from N6ARA and send them your fist. Snap a photo and mock up a quick SSTV and bounce it off the ionosphere. Or my most used mode - chase rare DX on FT8 (and FT4 and FT2) when you wake up in the middle of the night for a quick run to the powder room. It's really that easy -- then log it all with one click. Slick!

Select the entities you want to chase (POTA, SOTA, DX Clusters, WWFF, LLOTA, Tiles on the Air) and the region you want to see (North America, South America, Europe, etc), and enjoy two views: 

SPOTS View - See all the spots in a nice, large view showcasing the operator's callsign, name, distance from your QTH, mode and park/summit

MAP View - See a beautiful map with pins at all the activating spots. Click a spot to see their callsign, 1-click tune to them by pressing "QSY" and work the contact on SSB or CW. 

DIRECTORY view shows a list of current and upcoming HF nets, as well as Short Wave Listening (SWL) stations. Now you can tune into a net on a long drive and chat with your buddies, or catch the latest from Voice of Turkey.

By utilizing the SDR connection, you can connect ECHOCAT to your favorite KiwiSDR or WebSDR so you can listen to spots and nets even when your shack rig is unavailable. 

POTACAT CLOUD (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)

Subscribe to POTACAT Cloud to back up your logbook and sync QSOs between your phone and every desktop you operate from. Built for activators in the field, contesters with portable stations, and anyone with more than one shack.

+ POTACAT Cloud Tunnel — remote rig control from anywhere on the internet, no VPN required
+ Guest Pass — issue a time-limited, owner-revocable code that lets another licensed operator drive your station for a contest, a club session, or remote help. Server-enforced TX power and band limits
+ Cross-device QSO sync — log on mobile when your desktop is offline, watch it appear when you get home
+ Cloud backup with full ADIF export
+ Settings sync between devices
+ Multiple computers, one canonical log
+ Widgets to embed on QRZ that show your latest activation, total QSOs and more

73s,

K3SBP

Subscriptions: POTACAT Cloud is an auto-renewable subscription. Monthly and annual plans are available; pricing is shown at purchase. Subscription auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at purchase confirmation. Manage your subscription in your Apple ID account settings. Free trial converts to a paid subscription unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the trial ends.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://api.potacat.com/privacy-terms.html
Support: https://api.potacat.com/support

The BEST ArduPilot GCS for iPhone and iPadOS!

Works with ArduPilot autopilot via WiFi, Bluetooth Low Energy or Cellular connection, including 3DR Solo.
Supports ExpressLRS MAVLink telemetry.

NOTE: You must have either WiFi, Cellular or Serial Bluetooth connection to your drone.

User Manual is available at https://sidepilot.net

Features:
• Supports ArduCopter, ArduPlane and ArduRover via ELRS, WiFi or Bluetooth.
• Displays current drone location, with information such as altitude, yaw, pitch and roll.
• Internet ADSB to display nearby aircraft and provide warnings.
• Create, edit and delete waypoints and geofences.
• Audible alerts for important information.
• Edit, save and load parameters.
• Perform a Pre-Flight checklist with live weather information.
• Low battery warnings and alerts.
• View onboard video, and live stream it to YouTube.
• Record telemetry logs and export for sharing.
• Follow Me - Have your drone follow you using your devices GPS location, or visually with Object Tracking.
• Orbit mode - Automatically orbit an object for a fantastic cinematic shots!
• Grid Waypoints - Create a survey grid to fly.
• Tap to fly - Tap a location on the map to send your drone there!
• Perform calibrations at the field.
• DroneCAN Viewer and parameter editor.
• And many, many more...

Quick-start guide (Using a WiFi connection):
1. Turn on drone and connect using WiFi.
2. Start SidePilot, navigate to settings and select either WiFi UDP, TCP or 3DR Solo (as applicable).
3. If setting up WiFi manually, click on WiFi Settings and input the correct IP address and port that the MAVLink protocol is running over.
4. Go back to the main screen and press the connect button on the top right. The app will begin displaying information about the drone. If not, double check your WiFi settings.

Please post suggestions and bug reports on the SidePilot Facebook page or via email to tom@sidepilot.net


WARNING: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

Note: iPads without cellular do not have GPS capability unless tethered to a iOS Device with cellular, and even then it is poor and not suitable for navigation.

Spark: The Essential Tool for Managing Ren'Py Visual Novels

Spark is an independent utility for organizing and launching Ren'Py visual novels. It is not affiliated with or supported by the official Ren'Py project. For any issues with this app, please contact Spark support, not the Ren'Py team.

Launch and Play Your Novels with Ease
Import and start your favorite Ren'Py visual novels directly in Spark. Once added, your titles are ready to launch with a tap, so you can focus on reading and playing instead of manual setup.

Tailored Compatibility for Each Novel
Choose from multiple Ren'Py engine versions to match your novel and improve stability:
8.x: 8.5.4, 8.5.2, 8.5.0, 8.4.1, 8.3.7, 8.3.4, 8.2.3, 8.1.3, 8.0.3  
7.x: 7.8.8, 7.8.4, 7.7.3, 7.6.3, 7.5.3, 7.4.11  

Per-novel configuration lets you:
- Select the best Ren'Py version for each title
- Fine-tune settings to improve quality of life.
- Improve performance on complex or older games

Note: Performance and compatibility vary by novel. Older titles or very large games may contain bugs or fail to run. Smaller devices can experience rendering issues. Some novels may not work at all, though we strive to support as many as possible.

Powerful Save Management
Take full control of your progress across all novels:
- View all saves in one place instead of hunting through folders
- Backup saves before big choices or endings so you can revisit them anytime
- Restore old saves if something breaks or you want to replay a specific branch
- Import saves from other devices and delete unwanted saves to keep things tidy

Organize Your Entire Library
Keep your Ren'Py collection clean and easy to navigate:
- See all installed novels at a glance
- Rename titles to match your personal library style
- Manage multiple versions of the same novel, such as different language patches or updated builds

Flexible Novel Import
Add new novels from a variety of common formats:
- Import from zip, apk, 7z, tar, or rar files
- Quickly bring in titles from backups, downloads, or other devices
Once imported, novels become part of your Spark library with version and save management ready to use.

Ren'Py-Specific Tools and Enhancements
Dig deeper into your visual novels with advanced utilities:

Gallery Viewer
- Browse novel assets directly inside Spark
- View\Play images, videos, and music used by the game

Variable Editor
- View and edit game variables while playing
- Skip grinding, fix bugged flags, or jump to specific routes by adjusting in-game values

On-Device Translation
- Translate novels using Apple’s on-device translation system
- Make foreign-language titles more approachable without leaving the app
- Keep translations private and fast by staying on your device

Your Gateway to the Ren'Py Visual Novel Universe
While Spark is not affiliated with Ren'Py, it is designed as a powerful companion for players who want full control over how they install, launch, customize, and maintain their Ren'Py visual novels in one place.

Additional Licensing Information
Ren'Py includes free software licensed under various terms, including the GNU Lesser General Public License. For a complete list of included software and license details, please visit the official Ren'Py website.

Terms of Use
https://spark.devl.ai/reference/terms/

leads.description:
Itsytv is a remote control for Apple TV that shows you what's playing.

Connect to any Apple TV on your network and control it with a familiar touch interface. The circular d-pad supports taps, swipes, and directional input. All the buttons you need are right there – back, home, play/pause, volume, and a keyboard for search fields.

ERGONOMIC DESIGN
Built for both left-handed and right-handed use. Drag the remote to whichever side of the screen feels natural. You can also reposition it vertically to find the most comfortable spot for your grip.

NOW PLAYING WITH SEEK BAR
See what's on at a glance. The now playing bar shows artwork, title, and artist with transport controls for skip, play, and pause. Drag the seek bar to scrub to any point in the content directly from your phone – no need to hold down the d-pad like on the Siri Remote.

WHAT'S PLAYING
When you're watching something, Itsytv looks up the show or movie and displays the backdrop, plot summary, rating, genres, and cast – all without leaving the remote. Tap the info area to see the full detail view with cast photos and credits, then tap again to return to the remote.

APP LAUNCHER
Browse and launch apps installed on your Apple TV. Drag to rearrange them in your preferred order. After launching an app, Itsytv can automatically switch back to the remote tab so you're ready to navigate.

KEYBOARD INPUT
Type directly into search fields and text inputs on your Apple TV. When a hardware keyboard is connected, use arrow keys, return, escape, space, and volume shortcuts to control your Apple TV without touching the screen.

UNIVERSAL APP
Works on macOS (menu bar app) and iPhone/iPad.

FEATURES
- Ergonomic design for left-handed and right-handed use
- Circular d-pad with tap, swipe, and directional input
- Play/pause, volume, back, home, and power buttons
- Now playing bar with artwork, seek bar, and transport controls
- On-screen keyboard for text input and search
- Hardware keyboard support with arrow keys and shortcuts
- App launcher with drag-to-reorder
- Content info with backdrop, plot, rating, genres, and cast
- Scrollable detail view with full cast and crew
- Automatic reconnection to your last Apple TV
- Multiple Apple TV support with quick switching
- Works on iPhone and iPad

REQUIREMENTS
- Apple TV (4th generation or later)
- iPhone or iPad on the same Wi-Fi network
- One-time pairing with a PIN code shown on your TV
